evidenceLevels.documented: The provider's own documentation describes it.
evidenceLevels.observed: Seen working in device tests or by several third parties. Undocumented: it can break at any time.
evidenceLevels.conflicting: Sources disagree. Needs a device test.
evidenceLevels.unverified: Plausible, but no reliable report either way.
evidenceLevels.unsupported: Known not to work, or no mechanism exists.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.autoSubmitNote: Runs the question as soon as it opens (device tests 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-17).
providers.requiresLogin: Varies: signed out, the iPhone sent the question and then asked to sign in, and after sign-in the message was gone (iPhone and desktop, 2026-11-16). Android answered signed out without asking (2026-11-17).

variants.note: Undocumented ?q= parameter (browser search-engine format). Device-tested: the exact message arrives and is sent at once; it opened in the browser, not the app, on iPhone and Android.
